violations.text: Menus are lacking an allergy statement. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the front service area. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the can opener base, freezer, and table beneath burners & grill have an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The area outside the kitchen door has an accumulation of vegetation. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
